## Checklist

- [ ] No personal health information, secrets or real API keys in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit / integration / end-to-end, as fits)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm test`, `npm run test:int` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] UI changes checked in light and dark, at 375 px and desktop, and with the keyboard (see docs/design.md)
- [ ] Nothing recommends starting, stopping, switching or dosing a medication
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `.env.example`, the module's SPEC) if behavior or settings changed
